title: Joint Law of a Random Assignment
statement: Let $V$ and $D$ be finite sets, and assign to each variable $v\in V$ a probability law on $D$. The sampling law on assignments $V\to D$ is the joint law in which the variables are independent and each variable has its assigned marginal law.
hypotheses_covered: Each variable in $V$ is assigned a probability law on $D
